faq_heading: Questions founders ask about handing LinkedIn outreach to an agent

faqs.q: Will the agent sound like a salesperson spamming my network?
faqs.a: It should not. Messages are short, written for each person from facts you approve, and sent at a modest daily pace. Follow-ups stop the moment someone replies. You can see the wording and change it.

faqs.q: Do I have to talk to prospects myself?
faqs.a: Only the ones who show real interest. Warm replies reach you on WhatsApp the same day with the conversation, so you step in for the call and skip the cold part.

faqs.q: How much of my time does it take?
faqs.a: Some time up front to explain what you sell, who you want to reach and what you do not want said. After that, a short weekly review of the report and the warm replies.

faqs.q: Can I stop or change direction if it is not working?
faqs.a: Yes. It is a monthly service, so you can change the target, adjust the message or stop. We suggest judging it over a full month on reach, acceptances, real replies and booked calls.

faqs.q: Does it put my LinkedIn account at risk?
faqs.a: Any automation carries some risk, because LinkedIn restricts spam-style activity. Keeping volume modest, personal and paced like a careful person is the best way to reduce it.
